
• Signing in to a community's website uses the newer sign-in. When a community supports it, approving once also lets that website keep your member directory card up to date, for up to 12 hours or until you sign out. Communities that haven't upgraded keep working as before.
• Sign in as any identity your agent holds for that community, including one you made with the browser plugin. If more than one fits, Keyring asks which to use. An identity you joined with on another of your phones isn't offered on this phone yet.
• Before you join a community that publishes it, Keyring shows what its member directory would show about you, and to whom, and won't send your request under terms you weren't shown.
• Memberships won through private vetting keep their "Joined with private vetting" mark.
• Notifications: if your phone's notification token arrives late, Keyring now picks it up by itself, without turning notifications off and on.
• If Keyring restarts while it's still connecting to your agent, it checks again by itself instead of waiting for you.
• Also includes everything in build 263.
